description: Test suite for the React component 'Target' using @testing-library/react. Contains tests verifying accessibility attributes, click behavior, and keyboard interaction of the Target component.

methods.name: test('has aria-label and is focusable')
methods.description: Verifies that the Target component renders with proper accessibility roles and label, and can be focused programmatically.

methods.name: test('fires onHit only once for a click')
methods.description: Ensures that clicking the Target component triggers the onHit callback only once, even with multiple clicks, considering the delay.

methods.name: test('keyboard Enter triggers once')
methods.description: Checks that pressing the Enter key on the Target component calls the onHit callback exactly once.
